title: Emails and Correspondence Vocabulary
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas el vocabulario esencial para redactar y manejar correos electrónicos corporativos.

parts.visual: Partes de un email: To (para), From (de), Subject (asunto/tema principal), CC (con copia), BCC (con copia oculta), Attachment (archivo adjunto).
parts.audio: Parts of an email: To, From, Subject, CC, BCC, and Attachment, which is the file you send with the email.

parts.visual: Acciones comunes: To reply (responder), To reply all (responder a todos), To forward (reenviar), To attach (adjuntar), To delete (borrar), To draft (redactar/borrador).
parts.audio: Common actions: To reply, to reply all, to forward, to attach, to delete, and to draft.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta relacionada con correos electrónicos.

questions.question: Write the topic in the ____ line. (Asunto).
questions.explanation: Subject = asunto o tema del correo.

questions.question: Please find the report in the ____. (Archivo adjunto).
I will ____ this email to the manager. (Reenviar).
Don't forget to ____ the manager in this email. (Poner con copia).
I need to ____ to her email right now. (Responder).
Please don't ____ to everyone in the company. (Responder a todos).
I need to ____ a PDF file to the message. (Adjuntar).
The message is saved in my ____. (Borradores).
I have 50 unread emails in my ____. (Bandeja de entrada).
If you don't need it, just ____ it. (Bórralo).
You can find deleted emails in the ____. (Papelera).
The email is in the ____ folder. (Enviados).
I think the email went to the ____ folder. (Correo no deseado).
Use ____ if you want to hide the recipient's email address. (Copia oculta).
Could you ____ the invoice to this email? (Adjuntar).
I will ____ your request to the IT department. (Reenviar).
Please leave the ____ line clear and concise. (Asunto).
Did you ____ my last email? (Recibir).
I need to ____ an email to the client right now. (Enviar).
Sorry, I forgot the ____. Here is the file. (Archivo adjunto).
questions.explanation: Attachment = el archivo adjunto en sí.

stages.title: Written Expression
